gloss: to let go of; to part with

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {手放|てばな}しませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {手放|てばな}していなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {手放|てばな}していませんでした

definitions.gloss: to let go of; to release one's hold
definitions.explanation: To physically release something from one's hand.

definitions.gloss: to part with; to give up
definitions.explanation: To sell, dispose of, or give away something one has owned.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手放|てばな}さないで。
examples.english: Don't let go of the child's hand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手放|てばな}す⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I decided to part with my old car.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どうしても→どうしても：03476_doushitemo⟧{手放|てばな}せない。
examples.english: I just can't part with this book.
examples.notes: {手放|てばな}せない = can't let go of (emotionally attached)

examples.japanese: ⟦ロープ→ロープ：27860_roopu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手放|てばな}さないで。
examples.english: Don't let go of the rope.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手放|てばな}して⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
examples.english: I sold my house and moved to a small apartment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手放|てばな}す⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦つらかった→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧。
examples.english: It was hard to part with the watch I had treasured.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}くて→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手放|てばな}し⟦そう→そう：01167_sou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The wind was so strong I almost let go of my umbrella.

notes:
{手放|てばな}す is a transitive godan verb meaning to let go of or to part with something. The compound comes from ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + ⟦{放|はな}す→放す：29986_hanasu⟧ (to release).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)

ASPECT (ている):
{手放|てばな}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ means 'has parted with' (completed action), not an ongoing state.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手放|てばな}す: to let go of ~, to part with ~
- {手放|てばな}せない: can't bring oneself to part with (emotional attachment)
- {手放|てばな}し⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}ぶ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧: to rejoice unreservedly (adverbial use)

USAGE:
Sense 1 (physical) is literal: releasing grip on something. Sense 2 (giving up possessions) is more common in daily use, especially for selling or disposing of property, cars, or treasured items. The negative form {手放|てばな}せない often expresses emotional attachment.
